_comment: The Mac demo: the same rules as windows.json (see the reasons there). heartbeatGraceSec stays 90 here: the Mac player writes its first beat from its first frame, 1.2 s after the process start, and was ready after 1.8 s (measurements/day5/boot-to-first-heartbeat.json).
backoff.unstableRuns 3 / maxRestSec 600 / stableAfterSec 120: after 3 starts in a row that never stayed healthy the rest doubles up to 10 minutes; one start that stays healthy for 2 minutes ends it.
